author: gbolahan
content:
Hello guys, this might be a little out of place in this channel, but I'm currently open to working with any team doing protocol or systems-level engineering, or anyone who could use an extra pair of hands on a technical problem.

My background is primarily in systems engineering. I'm comfortable working across different languages, though Rust and Go are my strongest languages.

I'm particularly interested in protocol development, distributed systems, storage, and infrastructure. I'm very comfortable in uncharted territory. Happy to start immediately if anyone is interested or knows of an opportunity
